title: TelemetryWindow
description: A bounded slice of sensor data attached to a DiagnosticCase as evidence. The engine never consumes raw streams; everything flows through windowed extracts so feature derivation, DQ, and audit can be re-run deterministically.

sample_rate_hz.description: Native sample rate of the slowest sensor; downsampled bands captured separately.

operating_state.description: Asset state during the window. Used to segment features and avoid mixing operating regimes.

unit.description: SI unit, e.g. L/min, kPa, A.

stale_seconds.description: Maximum age of any sample in the window vs end_at.

feature_set_id.description: FK into a feature-derivation manifest (which features were extracted, which model can consume this window).

extraction_version.description: Version of the extraction pipeline used (e.g. tw_extract.v0.2.1).
